title: EVALUATING LLM SIMULATORS AS DIFFERENTIALLY PRIVATE DATA GENERATORS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring feature-level distribution drift by comparing the age and retirement status proportions in LLM-generated synthetic personas against the real-world baseline data.

Evaluating distribution drift by analyzing transaction time-of-day patterns in the generated synthetic data against real data to identify overrepresented business hour clustering and missing night/evening transactions.
Measuring distribution fidelity using Total Variation Distance (TVD) to assess whether the LLM accurately preserves binary gender proportions from the differentially private input statistics.
